scope: Fresh native process wall time: process startup, identical text input transfer and decoding, input preflight, calculation, JSON output and stdout transfer. All executables are compiled before any timed run. Source admission, checked plan selection, fresh checking/code emission, native compilation and external output audits are outside the samples and reported separately. beryl is specialized to each shape; the direct C/Rust formulas accept bounded shapes. This is process latency, not a kernel-only or language speed ranking.

methodology.audit: Every warm-up and measured output checked against an external direct formula after timing.
methodology.compilation: All beryl, C and Rust executables compiled before the first warm-up.
methodology.native_target: Observe whether beryl median process latency is within 2x of each baseline; this is a target, not a guarantee.

input_generation.checkerboard: low = (31 * iteration) % 1024; high = (1023 - 29 * iteration) % 1024; input[row,column] = high if (row + column + iteration) % 2 else low

public_provenance_note: Absolute workspace and temporary paths are reduced to file names. Source contents, archive/module/compiler/binary hashes, flags, durations and samples are unchanged.
